candidates.description: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey just posted the biggest movie opening of Nolan's career, and audiences didn't show up for Matt Damon, Tom Holland, or Zendaya. Surveys found Nolan himself was the number one reason moviegoers bought a ticket, more than any actor in a cast stacked with A-listers. Universal spent $250M on the film and gave Nolan near-total creative control to get it, following a pattern already playing out with directors like Ryan Coogler and Greta Gerwig landing unprecedented deals of their own.
